item.content:encoded:
The assorted contents of Junior Researcher Renfield's bagged lunch

Gee, I wonder what sort of noodle incident caused that?

Anyway, as others said, "Extremely ionised" isn't exactly right. "Highly" should be used in that cause.

And how the heck did the helicopter recover it when it was gliding all over the place without shredding it on the propellers?

The testing log probably needs more detail put into it, it looks kind of short and only there to provide some climax to the article.

So, as workable as it is, no vote. It's not bad, but could use improvement.
